38212-the-making-of-william-edwards-or-t.title: _The Story Of The Bridge Of Beauty_
38212-the-making-of-william-edwards-or-t.creator: Mrs. G. Linnæus Banks
38212-the-making-of-william-edwards-or-t.description: A book by Mrs. G. Linnæus Banks. It was a sad day for Mrs. Edwards, of Eglwysilan,[1] when her well-loved husband, on his return from Llantrissant market one sultry Friday in the autumn of 1721, in attempting to cross the River Taff, failed to observe its rising waters, missed the ford, and was carried down the stream, a drowning man.

58914-the-white-eagle-of-poland.title: Of Poland
58914-the-white-eagle-of-poland.creator: E. F. Benson
58914-the-white-eagle-of-poland.description: A book by E. F. Benson. ssia, since they mildly remembered that the Tsar of all the Russias was also King of Poland, much as the German Emperor was also King of Prussia. And fewest of all even among the skilled and well-informed augurs of political omens saw or guessed that before the war was over Poland would have acquired so huge a significance as it, and the problems connected with it, imply to-day.

arxiv-1402-6808.title: Parallel Lepton Mass Matrices with Texture/Cofactor Zeros
arxiv-1402-6808.creator: Weijian Wang
arxiv-1402-6808.description: Abstract In this paper we investigate the parallel texture structures containing texture zeros in charged lepton mass matrix M l M_{l} and cofactor zeros in neutrino mass matrix M ν M_{\nu} . These textures are interesting since they are related to the Z n Z_{n} flavor symmetries.

arxiv-1506-03323.title: Propagation of correlations in Local Random Quantum Circuits.
arxiv-1506-03323.creator: Siddhartha Santra and Radhakrishnan Balu
arxiv-1506-03323.description: Abstract We derive a dynamical bound on the propagation of correlations in local random quantum circuits - lattice spin systems where piecewise quantum operations - in space and time - occur with classical probabilities. Correlations are quantified by the Frobenius norm of the commutator of two positive operators acting on space-like separated local Hilbert spaces.

arxiv-1907-01535.title: G G -fixed Hilbert schemes on K ​ 3 K3 surfaces, modular forms, and eta products
arxiv-1907-01535.creator: Jim Bryan, Ádám Gyenge
arxiv-1907-01535.description: Abstract Abstract. Let X be a complex K3 surface with an effective action of a group G which preserves the holomorphic symplectic form. Let Z_{X,G}(q)=\sumop\displaylimits_{n=0}^{\infty}e\left(\operatorname{Hilb}^{n}(X)^{G}\right)\,q^{n-1} be the generating function for the Euler characteristics of the Hilbert schemes of G -invariant length n subschemes.

arxiv-2502-05229.title: L2GNet: Optimal Local-to-Global Representation of Anatomical Structures for Generalized Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2502-05229.creator: Vandan Gorade, Sparsh Mittal, Neethi Dasu, Rekha Singhal, KC Santosh, Debesh Jha
arxiv-2502-05229.description: Abstract Continuous Latent Space (CLS) and Discrete Latent Space (DLS) models, like AttnUNet and VQUNet, have excelled in medical image segmentation. In contrast, Synergistic Continuous and Discrete Latent Space (CDLS) models show promise in handling fine and coarse-grained information. However, they struggle with modeling long-range dependencies.

arxiv-2503-19571.title: Null Geodesics, Thermodynamics, Weak Gravitational Lensing, and Black Hole Shadow Characteristics of a Frolov Regular Black Hole with Constraints from EHT Observations
arxiv-2503-19571.creator: Shubham Kala, Hemwati Nandan, Kush Maithani, Saswati Roy, Amare Abebe
arxiv-2503-19571.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the properties of null geodesics, thermodynamics, gravitational lensing, and black hole shadows in the vicinity of a static regular Frolov black hole. By analyzing the trajectories of null geodesics, we investigate the bending of light in weak field regimes.

arxiv-2504-17192.title: Paper2Code: Automating Code Generation from Scientific Papers in Machine Learning
arxiv-2504-17192.creator: Minju Seo, Jinheon Baek, Seongyun Lee, Sung Ju Hwang
arxiv-2504-17192.description: Abstract Despite the rapid growth of machine learning research, corresponding code implementations are often unavailable, making it slow and labor-intensive for researchers to reproduce results and build upon prior work. In the meantime, recent Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at understanding scientific documents and generating high-quality code.

pmc-10674475.title: Influence of Type of Cross-Linking Agent on Structure and Transport Properties of Polydecylmethylsiloxane
pmc-10674475.creator: Evgenia Grushevenko, Tatiana Rokhmanka, Stepan Sokolov, Andrey Basko, Ilya Borisov, Konstantin Pochivalov, Alexey Volkov
pmc-10674475.description: The development of membrane materials with high transport and separation properties for the removal of higher hydrocarbons from gas mixtures is an important and complex task. This work examines the effect of a cross-linking agent on the structure and transport properties of polydecylmethylsiloxane (C10), a material characterized by high selectivity towards C3+ hydrocarbons.

pmc-11417039.title: Development of a RPA-CRISPR/Cas12a based rapid visual detection assay for Porcine Parvovirus 7
pmc-11417039.creator: Shubo Wen, Lemuge She, Sheng Dang, Ao Liao, Xiaorui Li, Shuai Zhang, Yang Song, Xiangyang Li, Jingbo Zhai
pmc-11417039.description: IntroductionPorcine Parvovirus (PPV) is a significant pathogen in the pig industry, with eight genotypes, including PPV7, identified since its emergence in 2016. Co-infections with viruses such as Porcine Circovirus 2 (PCV2) and Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome Virus (PRRSV) pose serious risks to swine health.

pmc-12437852.title: Factor Models as an Important Tool in Creating the Effective Quality Management System in Psychiatric Institutions
pmc-12437852.creator: V Mitikhin, T Solokhina, D Oshevsky
pmc-12437852.description: IntroductionMedical staff is one of the main participants in psychiatric care quality management system. At the same time, it is not enough to ensure high level of staff qualifications only. It is also necessary to determine staff satisfaction with their professional activities, levels of staff well-being and of professional burden.

pmc-12566101.title: The Effect of the Clinical-Pathological CPS+EG Staging System on Survival Outcomes in Patients with HER2-Positive Breast Cancer Receiving Neoadjuvant Treatment: A Retrospective Study
pmc-12566101.creator: Seval Orman, Miray Aydoğan, Oğuzcan Kınıkoğlu, Sedat Yıldırım, Nisanur Sarıyar Busery, Hacer Şahika Yıldız, Ezgi Türkoğlu, Tuğba Kaya, Deniz Işık, Seval Ay Ersoy, Hatice Odabaş, Nedim Turan, Seung-Gu Yeo
pmc-12566101.description: Background and Objectives: To evaluate the prognostic value of the Clinical–Pathologic Stage–Estrogen receptor status and Grade (CPS+EG) staging system, which combines clinical staging, pathological staging, oestrogen receptor (ER) status, and tumour grade in predicting survival outcomes in patients with human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-positive breast cancer receiving neoadjuvant therapy (NACT).

pmc-12588141.title: Adherence to Iron and Folic Acid (IFA) among Women Availing Antenatal Services at a Rural Maternity Hospital in Karnataka
pmc-12588141.creator: Kadambari Nanmaran, Avita R. Johnson, Rhea James, Malavika Nadig, Lavanya Varier, Anju Mathew
pmc-12588141.description: Antenatal Iron and Folic Acid (IFA) supplementation prevents anaemia and improves maternal and child outcomes. We conducted a hospital based cross sectional study in Ramanagara district to assess antenatal IFA adherence and its determinants in rural Karnataka. 200 pregnant women ≥16 weeks of gestation were recruited by consecutive sampling and administered a face validated, structured questionnaire.

pmc-12781513.title: Therapy-induced remodeling of IgG and plasma N-glycans in breast cancer
pmc-12781513.creator: Martina Maričić Vrban, Barbara Radovani Trbojević, David Visentin, Katarina Ramljak, Iva Kirac, Mihaela Gaće, Ivan Milas, Gordan Lauc, Dragan Primorac, Ivan Gudelj
pmc-12781513.description: BackgroundProtein N-glycosylation plays a key role in cancer biology and may offer insights into tumor behavior and treatment response. This study investigated changes in N-glycosylation of immunoglobulin G (IgG) and total plasma proteins in patients with breast cancer undergoing neoadjuvant chemotherapy.MethodsA prospective cohort of 34 women with early-stage or locally advanced breast cancer was recruited.

pmc-13284471.title: Fat phenomics reveals shared genetic architecture of abdominal fat and yolk lipids: Insight into the potential for divergent selection
pmc-13284471.creator: Wenxin Zhang, Fangren Lan, Ronglang Cai, Ning Yang, Congjiao Sun
pmc-13284471.description: Excessive abdominal fat deposition reduces production efficiency and metabolic health, whereas yolk lipid content is directly linked to egg quality and reproductive output. These two fat-related traits are often in conflict from a breeding perspective, yet whether they share common genetic and molecular determinants—and whether such sharing could inform divergent selection for lean abdomen with lipid‑rich yolk—remains unclear.

pmc-13291060.creator: Baltazar Chilundo, Laura Xinavane, Luísa Huo, Fátima Abacassamo, Luc Van der Veken, Benigna Matsinhe, Paula Morgado, Claudia Abreu Lopes

pmc-13380371.title: Alkali‐Metal Base Catalyzed Electrocyclization of Isoprene Derivatives
pmc-13380371.creator: Mikaël Le Roch, Krzysztof Piech, Aurélien Crochet, Andreu Tortajada
pmc-13380371.description: The catalytic electrocyclization of heptatrienes represents an attractive strategy to access seven‐membered carbocycles from acyclic precursors, whose medium‐size cyclic saturated hydrocarbon counterparts display physicochemical properties of interest for jet‐fuel applications. Here we uncover the potential of alkali‐metal amides to enable an efficient, high‐yielding and multigram‐scale electrocyclization of biobased ocimene and related trienes derived from isoprene.

pmc-13465964.title: Development and validation of the Korea University Social Isolation Scale
pmc-13465964.creator: Jaehee Jung, Jueun Hwang, Juhee Choi, Ye-Seul Kim, Jisoo Park, Yong-Chun Bahk, Kee-Hong Choi
pmc-13465964.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSocial isolation is a complex phenomenon encompassing behavioral, cognitive, emotional, and functional dimensions that represents a major public health issue. Beyond reduced social contact, it is associated with subjective distress and difficulties in academic and occupational engagement.

pmc-13502973.title: The Bacterial, Viral, and Microbiome Contributions in Cardiovascular Diseases: A Narrative Review
pmc-13502973.creator: Shyamala Ravikoti, Vikas Bhatia, Mohanasundari Saykkulandai Kuppuswamy
pmc-13502973.description: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are the leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. While traditional risk factors such as hypertension, diabetes, and lifestyle behaviors are well-documented, emerging evidence highlights the role of microbial agents in contributing to cardiovascular risk. This narrative review explores the epidemiological evidence linking various microbes, including bacteria, viruses, and other pathogens, to cardiovascular diseases.

pmc-13590398.title: Prenatal valproic acid exposure in rodent models of autism: a systematic review of neurobehavioral physiological alterations
pmc-13590398.creator: İbrahim Hakkı Çağıran, Dursun Alper Yilmaz
pmc-13590398.description: IntroductionRodent models based on prenatal valproic acid (VPA) exposure are widely used to investigate autism spectrum disorder (ASD)-related neurobehavioral and biological alterations. Over the past two years, the rapid expansion of VPA-based research incorporating advanced molecular, neuroimaging, electrophysiological, and microbiota analyses has generated a substantial but fragmented body of evidence.
